title: Spicy Kenyan Lamb Tagine Tacos
description: A fusion of traditional African and Mexican flavors, this lamb tagine is served in a crispy taco shell with a side of fresh cilantro and lime.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
Add the piquant, kenyan, tagine, onion, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb back to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few pieces of the lamb mixture onto a tortilla and topping with avocado or sour cream, cilantro, and any other desired toppings.
